title: A first-quadrant resolution-column augmentation induces a total quasi-isomorphism
statement: Let C be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], K a first-quadrant double complex [def-sp-double-complex-total], A a nonnegative cochain complex, and a:A→K.X 0 a chain map satisfying a≫K.d 0 1=0. Let b:A→Tot(K) be a chain map whose degree-n component is a.f n followed by the (0,n) total inclusion. Assume for every n that the map from A.X n concentrated in resolution degree zero to the resolution column K.flip.X n, with degree-zero component a.f n, is a quasi-isomorphism (meaning an isomorphism on every homology object). Then b is a quasi-isomorphism.

source.place: Lemma 12.25.4, variant involving the second variable

proof.text: Construct S by applying the degree-zero single-complex functor termwise to A, then flipping. Its resolution column n is definitionally A.X n concentrated at zero. Use fromSingle₀Equiv to construct a morphism S.flip→K.flip from the augmentation; the chain-map law at zero is a.comm and at positive resolution degrees follows from zero source objects. Flip it to f:S→K. The hypothesis hcol is definitionally the columnwise quasi-isomorphism hypothesis for f.

Construct e:A→Tot(S) using the diagonal (0,n) inclusions. Check the chain-map law using the total differential: the resolution differential is zero and the other total sign at resolution zero is +1. Each e.f n has inverse totalDesc, using A.XIsoOfEq on resolution zero and zero elsewhere. Check both inverse equations using the diagonal coproduct universal property and the zero positive-resolution summands. Hence e is an isomorphism.

Apply the general column comparison to f. The total inclusion naturality formula and hb show e≫Tot(f)=b, component by component. The composite of the isomorphism e and the quasi-isomorphism Tot(f) is a quasi-isomorphism. All these constructions and equalities are proved in Lean.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 12.25.4, finite-diagonal argument, applied to column cones

lean.statement: theorem quasiIso_of_column_augmentation {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] (K : HomologicalComplex₂ C (ComplexShape.up ℕ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)) (A : CochainComplex C ℕ) (a : A ⟶ K.X 0) (ha : a ≫ K.d 0 1 = 0) (b : A ⟶ K.total (ComplexShape.up ℕ)) (hb : ∀ n : ℕ, b.f n = a.f n ≫ K.ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 n n (by simp)) (hcol : ∀ n : ℕ, QuasiIso ((CochainComplex.fromSingle₀Equiv (K.flip.X n) (A.X n)).symm ⟨a.f n, by simpa using congrArg (fun f ↦ f.f n) ha⟩)) : QuasiIso b
